title: Article economic-data.json
description: Per-article artefact produced by agentic workflows during the pre-article analysis phase. Bridges World Bank / IMF / SCB MCP tool output into the Chart.js-powered 'Economic Context' dashboard emitted by `scripts/data-transformers/content-generators/economic-dashboard-section.ts`. Written to `analysis/daily/YYYY-MM-DD/{analysisSubfolder}/economic-data.json`. Schema v2.0 (additive): adds `source.imf[]` and optional `provider`, `projection`, `projectionVintage` fields on each data point. Schema v1 artefacts (`source` with only `worldBank` and `scb`) remain valid.

version.description: Contract version — '1.0' (WB + SCB only) or '2.0' (adds IMF + provider/projection fields). Schema accepts both; the validator enforces the version floor.

articleType.description: Article type slug the context was produced for (e.g. 'committee-reports').

policyDomains.description: Policy domains detected from the source documents (e.g. 'fiscal policy', 'defence', 'labor market'). Fed to `findIndicatorsForDomains`.

dataPoints.description: World Bank data points (may be empty only when `skip` is true).

commentary.description: AI-authored commentary paragraph (2–4 sentences) that cites 2–3 concrete values from `dataPoints`. Rendered as the dashboard section summary.

source.description: Attribution sources the workflow actually queried. For schema v1 back-compat, `worldBank` and `scb` are always present (may be empty). For schema v2.0+, `imf` is also accepted. At least one of the three arrays MUST be non-empty unless `skip: true`.

worldBank.description: World Bank indicator IDs (e.g. 'NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG'). Kept for governance (WGI), environment, long-horizon social/education series where IMF does not provide coverage.

scb.description: SCB table IDs (e.g. 'TAB1291'). Swedish primary source — unchanged.

imf.description: IMF database/indicator citation strings (e.g. 'WEO:NGDP_RPCH', 'FM:GGXWDG_NGDP', 'IFS:FIMM_PA'). Populated by the `imf` MCP server or the native `scripts/imf-client.ts` for macro/fiscal/monetary indicators from `data.imf.org` (SDMX 3.0).

skip.description: Set to true only for article types on the exempt allow-list (e.g. pure-process realtime monitor stories). `dataPoints` may be empty when this is true.

skipReason.description: Brief free-form reason when skip=true (required by the validator allow-list).

countryCode.description: ISO-3 country code (e.g. 'SWE', 'DNK', 'NOR', 'FIN', 'DEU'). IMF area codes (e.g. '111' for USA in GFS) MUST be resolved to ISO-3 before writing.

indicatorId.description: Provider-native indicator ID. World Bank example: 'NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG'. IMF example: 'NGDP_RPCH' (WEO) or 'GGXWDG_NGDP' (FM). SCB example: 'TAB1291'.

value.description: Numeric value of the indicator for the country/date.

provider.description: Schema v2.0+ — which authoritative source produced this data point. Required for IMF data points; defaults to 'worldBank' when omitted for back-compat with v1 artefacts.

projection.description: Schema v2.0+ — true when the value is a forecast (IMF WEO / Fiscal Monitor projections typically extend to T+5). Article commentary may cite projected values only when this flag is true AND the article type is on the look-ahead allow-list (week-ahead, month-ahead, weekly-review, monthly-review).

projectionVintage.description: Schema v2.0+ — vintage tag of the projection release (e.g. 'WEO-2026-04', 'FM-2026-04'). Required when `projection: true`. Enables the audit to surface stale vintages.
